The '''Carbonite Sith Tomb''' was a structure on a rocky [[Unidentified planet (Carbonite Tomb)|planet]] that housed a [[Carbonite Sith Army]] along with a [[Carbonite Sith Master]]. The [[Carbonite Sith Army holocron]] led to this place. Supposedly years later after the army was frozen, it was found by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Silri]].
